fact: A new service of the Sistema de Informação Policial da África Ocidental (SIPAO) was inaugurated beside the Guarda Nacional command (ex-QG) in Bissau, described as a centre for collecting and processing information where all the police forces gather to work and share it, cross-checking the data of the different forces over the INTERPOL channel.
title: Polícia Judiciária/ Diretor Nacional diz que a luta contra a criminalidade organizada exige nova estratégia
